points.description: States that leg bones are large because they carry/support a lot of weight (the body's weight). Equivalent wording accepted, e.g. 'they support the body's mass' or 'they bear heavy loads'.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying leg bones carry or support a lot of weight (body weight). No mark for answers that do not mention weight or load, e.g. only saying legs are used for movement.
